title: 第44章 同居日常与《画皮》
content_zh:
第44章 同居日常与《画皮》-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

吃过早饭，刘施施的心情慢慢平静下来。

本来今天约着一起逛街。

现在看瞎姐这状态，估计没多少体力逛街。

于是，他们干脆就窝在家里打游戏。

“啧啧。你这电脑配置不错啊。”

网瘾少年刘施施看着眼前的电脑，露出羡慕的小眼神。

“花了小两万配的，无聊的时候用来打游戏。”

“还是有钱好啊，不像我压根没钱。”

魏沐对此有些了解。

她去年签约唐人，初始合约为5年，分成三七开。

公司七成，艺人三成，典型的新人合约。

加入唐人这两年，刘施施接了一些戏，都不是主角，片酬没多少。

分成低，还要花不少钱买化妆品和衣服，自然存不了钱。

“别急，等《仙剑三》播出，你就能大火。”

“哈哈，你也是，我们还是剧里情侣呢！！”

想起这个，坐在魏沐怀里的刘施施忍不住傻笑。

跟男朋友一起拍戏，还是演情侣，她愿意天天待在剧组。

打开电脑，蹦出熟悉Windowsxp开机音效。

这段音乐太经典了，年代感扑面而来。

趁着开机的时候，怀里的女孩关切问道：“你今天不去录歌可以吗？”

“可以，我和老板说过，这几天在家里写歌词。”

“真羡慕你，我要是和K姐这样说，她能骂死我。”

刘施施噘着嘴，打开熟悉的贴吧网站，然后她就看到魏沐贴吧。

“我靠，你居然有自己的贴吧？”

“嗯，上戏学弟建的。”

当初学弟建立这个贴吧的时候，还想让他当吧主，魏沐以工作太忙推掉，最后混了个小吧。

目前贴吧的会员数不多，只有5万。

“5万不少了，我还没自己的贴吧呢！！”

“那我帮你建一个？”

“我不要。”

特么的，老娘好歹是一个演员，自己给自己建贴吧。

我刘施施不要面子的吗？

随便浏览一下贴吧，大部分都是《体面》这首歌的感悟贴。

还有好多在里面分享自己的分手经历。

其中一个评论数超多。

贴子楼主是一个即将毕业的大四学生。

她自己想留在魔都工作，而男友想回到老家发展，俩人因此分手。

听了这首歌以后，贴主觉得应该珍惜这段感情经历，于是和男友复合。

“哈哈，我和男友打算回锡市发展，准备年底见父母啦！！”

After breakfast, Liu Shishi's mood gradually calmed down.

We originally made an appointment to go shopping together today.

Looking at Blind Sister's current state, she probably doesn't have much energy to go shopping.

So, they simply stayed at home and played games.

"Tsk tsk. Your computer configuration is pretty good."

Internet-addicted boy Liu Shishi looked at the computer in front of him with envious eyes.

"I spent a small amount of 20,000 yuan on it. I use it to play games when I'm bored."

"It's better to have money, unlike me who have no money at all."

Wei Mu knew something about this.

She signed a contract with Tangren last year. The initial contract was for five years, divided into 30 and 70 splits.

70% for the company and 30% for the artist, a typical rookie contract.

In the two years since he joined Tang Dynasty, Liu Shishi has taken on some roles, but they were not leading roles and the pay was not much.

The share is low, and you have to spend a lot of money on cosmetics and clothes, so naturally you can't save money.

"Don't worry, you'll be a hit when "Sword and Sword III" is aired."

"Haha, you too, we are still a couple in the show!!"

Thinking of this, Liu Shishi, who was sitting in Wei Mu's arms, couldn't help but giggle.

Whether she is filming with her boyfriend or acting as a couple, she is willing to stay on the set every day.

Turn on the computer, and the familiar Windowsxp startup sound will pop up.

This piece of music is so classic, and it has a sense of age.

While the phone was on, the girl in her arms asked with concern: "Is it okay if you don't record a song today?"

"Okay, I told my boss that I will write lyrics at home these days."

"I really envy you. If I said this to Sister K, she would scold me to death."

Liu Shishi pouted and opened the familiar Tieba website, and then she saw Wei Mu Tieba.

"Holy shit, you actually have your own post?"

"Well, it was built by my junior classmate who went to the theater."

When the junior student established this post bar, he wanted to be the bar owner, but Wei Mu turned it down because he was too busy with work, and ended up working in a small bar.

Tieba currently has a small number of members, only 50,000.

“50,000 is a lot, and I don’t even have my own post yet!!”

"Then let me help you build one?"

"I don't want it."

Damn it, I am an actor after all, so I can create my own forum.

I, Liu Shishi, don’t want to lose face?

Browsing through the forums, most of them are posts about my thoughts on the song "Decent".

There are also many people sharing their breakup experiences there.

One of them has too many comments.

The poster is a senior who is about to graduate.

She herself wanted to stay and work in Shanghai, while her boyfriend wanted to return to his hometown to develop, so the two broke up.

After listening to this song, the poster felt that he should cherish this relationship experience, so he got back together with his boyfriend.

"Haha, my boyfriend and I plan to go back to Xishi to develop our lives, and we are going to meet our parents at the end of the year!!"

There are congratulatory comments below.
